# gitrepository

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-controller/pkg/controller/observers/gitrepository"
```

Package gitrepository re\-exports the gitrepository\-observer reconciler type as a public alias. The reconciler itself stays in internal/controller/observers/gitrepository, unchanged; this package exists only so that external test modules have a valid, non\-internal import path to construct it against.

<a name="Reconciler"></a>
## type Reconciler

Reconciler observes the Crossplane Repository backing a GitRepository CR and reflects its Ready condition back onto the GitRepository status.

```go
type Reconciler = internalgitrepository.Reconciler
```
